Sanjay has a cuboid with dimension of 6×4×4 cm. The face whose dimensions are 6×4 are coloured black. Other faces whose dimensions are 6×4 are coloured Pink and the faces whose dimensions are 4×4 coloured yellow. Now the cuboid is cut into small cubes of side 1 cm. How many small cubes have three face coloured?

properties.html:
Two adjacent faces of a cube are painted red and out of the remaining sides, two opposite face are painted green. The cube is then cut into 125 equal smaller cubes.

What is the difference between the number of smaller cubes with at least one side painted and the number of smaller cubes with no side painted?

properties.html:
Manoj cuts the cube in two equal parts along a plane parallel to one of its faces. One place is then coloured Green on the two larger faces and yellow on the remaining, while the other is coloured yellow on two smaller adjacent faces and Green on the remaining.

Each is then cut into 32 cubes of same size and mixed up.

How many small cubes have two green and one yellow face from both cubes?

properties.html: A cube having a volume of 216 cm^3 is painted with yellow colour on all its faces. It is then cut into smaller cubes of equal sizes. The side of the smaller cube thus formed is a prime number. How many of the smaller cubes will have two of its faces painted as yellow?

properties.html:
A kid is playing with 64 identical solid wooden cubes. He was trying to form a hollow cube, by sticking the smaller cubes. Then he painted it red on all its faces. Assume there are no hollow spaces between the cubes that are glued together, and that a hollow cube is a cube which is built by using not as many small cubes as it would require to build a solid cube. Also assume that walls of the hollow cube are not hollow i.e. only inside of the cube is hollow and not its surfaces.

If the hollow cube is of uniform wall thickness, out of the 64 smaller cubes what is the minimum number of cubes that have no painted faces?
